summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy materials for its Annual General Meeting to be held on June 26, 2026. The meeting will consider routine matters: receiving audited financials, re-electing three independent non-executive directors, fixing director remuneration, reappointing auditors, and granting a general mandate to allot shares. This is a standard AGM circular with no special-situation event such as a transaction, activist campaign, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the equivalent of a U.S. proxy statement but for routine governance items only.
